fullTextEN: Hello,
Hello everyone,
I am Xiaoxiao,
I am from Henan, China,
In the last video,

fullTextZH: 我给大家介绍了我生活在上海和生活在河南吃饭的区别，
fullTextEN: I introduced to everyone the differences between living in Shanghai and living in Henan regarding eating,
Do you still remember?
In this video,

fullTextZH: 我想给大家介绍一下我生活在上海和生活在河南出行的区别。
fullTextEN: I want to introduce to everyone the differences between living in Shanghai and living in Henan regarding transportation.
In Shanghai, if I want to go out,

fullTextZH: 比如去一个商场或者去一个饭店，
fullTextEN: for example, to a mall or a restaurant,
how do I usually get there?
Because I am not from Shanghai,
I study in Shanghai,

fullTextZH: 所以我没有自己的自行车，
fullTextEN: so I don't have my own bicycle,
nor do I have my own electric scooter,
let alone my own car,
because I think it's not worth it.

fullTextZH: 自行车、电动车和汽车都太贵了，
fullTextEN: Bicycles, electric scooters, and cars are all too expensive,
I don't have a job,
So there's no money to buy it,

fullTextZH: 并且居住在上海的人有很多，
fullTextEN: And there are many people living in Shanghai,
If I drive out,
The road will be very congested,
Especially during rush hour,
Everyone will be stuck on the road,

fullTextZH: 所以我出门一般有三种方式。
fullTextEN: So I generally have three ways to go out.

fullTextZH: 第一种是骑共享自行车，
fullTextEN: The first way is to ride a shared bike,

fullTextZH: 你们知道什么是共享自行车吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know what a shared bike is?

fullTextZH: 就是说这个自行车不是我的，
fullTextEN: It means this bike is not mine,
But I can ride it.

fullTextZH: 第二种方式就是坐地铁。
fullTextEN: The second way is to take the subway.
The third way is to take a taxi.
First is to ride a shared bike,
Shared bikes are very convenient,
There are many places in Shanghai that have them,

fullTextZH: 如果你的距离不远的话，
fullTextEN: If your distance is not far,

fullTextZH: 骑共享自行车是一个很好的选择，
fullTextEN: Riding a shared bike is a good choice,
You just need to take out your phone,
Scan the QR code on the bike,

fullTextZH: 你就可以骑这辆自行车了，
fullTextEN: You can ride this bicycle now,

fullTextZH: 不需要买一辆自己的自行车。
fullTextEN: No need to buy your own bicycle.
If the distance is very far,
I usually choose to take the subway,
Shanghai has many subways,

fullTextZH: 我可以坐地铁去到大部分的地方。
fullTextEN: I can take the subway to most places.
Taking the subway is also very cheap,
Within two kilometers, it only costs 3 yuan.

fullTextZH: 并且地铁还有一个好处就是它不会堵车，
fullTextEN: Moreover, the subway has the advantage that it doesn't get stuck in traffic,
It's very punctual,

fullTextZH: 对于要上班的人来说是一个很好的选择。
fullTextEN: which is a great choice for people who need to go to work.

fullTextZH: 那我什么时候会去打车呢？
fullTextEN: So when do I take a taxi?

fullTextZH: 大家知道有时候我们会去一些比较小的地方去旅游，
fullTextEN: Everyone knows sometimes we go to some relatively small places to travel,

fullTextZH: 这个时候坐地铁不太方便，
fullTextEN: At this time, taking the subway is not very convenient,

fullTextZH: 骑自行车距离又太远了，
fullTextEN: and riding a bicycle is too far,

fullTextZH: 这个时候打车就是一个很好的选择。
fullTextEN: At this time, taking a taxi is a great choice.

fullTextZH: 但是上海打车价格太贵了，
fullTextEN: But taking a taxi in Shanghai is too expensive,
so I rarely take a taxi,

fullTextZH: 但是在河南因为是我的老家，
fullTextEN: but in Henan, because it's my hometown,

fullTextZH: 所以我买了一辆自己的电动车，
fullTextEN: so I bought my own electric scooter,
Riding an electric scooter is very convenient,

fullTextZH: 我可以在任何时候骑电动车，
fullTextEN: I can ride an electric scooter at any time,

fullTextZH: 也可以骑电动车去任何我想到达的地方，
fullTextEN: I can also ride an electric scooter to any place I want to go,
It's all very convenient.
But if the weather is bad,
for example, when it rains,
clothes will get wet,

fullTextZH: 这个时候骑电动车就不是非常的方便，
fullTextEN: at this time, riding an electric scooter is not very convenient,

fullTextZH: 这个时候我会选择坐公交车，
fullTextEN: at this time, I would choose to take the bus,

fullTextZH: 我家这边的公交车是免费的，
fullTextEN: The bus in my area is free,
no cost,
so it's also very convenient.

fullTextZH: 除了公交车还有一个选择就是自己开车，
fullTextEN: Besides the bus, another option is to drive myself,

fullTextZH: 但是我的开车技术很不好，
fullTextEN: but my driving skills are not very good,
so I rarely drive myself,
but in my hometown,
the population is not as large as in Shanghai,

fullTextZH: 所以自己开车出门也是一个很好的选择。
fullTextEN: so driving myself is also a good option.

fullTextZH: 最近我在晚上散步的时候，
fullTextEN: Recently, when I take walks at night,

fullTextZH: 在路上看到了马车和狗拉车，
fullTextEN: I saw horse-drawn carriages and dog carts on the road,

fullTextZH: 在上海你很少在路边会看到马车或者是狗拉车，
fullTextEN: In Shanghai, you rarely see horse-drawn carriages or dog carts on the roadside,
It's really very interesting.
